base = np.array([[0.3, -0.7, 0.5], [0.2, 0.9, -0.4]])

    y = tf.reduce_sum(tf.square(tf.nn.gelu(x, approximate=True)))

    worst = max(worst, abs(n - g[i]))

import keras
from keras import layers
import tensorflow as tf
np.random.seed(0)
keras.utils.set_random_seed(0)
X = np.random.rand(2, 3, 2)
l = layers.GRU(2)
l(X)
def loss():
    return tf.reduce_sum(tf.square(l(X, training=True) - 1.0))
with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
    v = loss()
gs = tape.gradient(v, l.trainable_variables)
worst = 0.0
k = 0
for g in gs:
    w = l.get_weights()
    flat = w[k].ravel()
    shape = w[k].shape
    grad = g.numpy().ravel().tolist()
    for i in range(min(flat.size, 6)):
        w1 = l.get_weights()
        p = flat.copy()
        p[i] += 0.01
        w1[k] = p.reshape(shape)
        l.set_weights(w1)
        up = float(loss())
        p[i] -= 0.02
        w1[k] = p.reshape(shape)
        l.set_weights(w1)
        dn = float(loss())
        worst = max(worst, abs((up - dn) / 0.02 - grad[i]))
    l.set_weights(w)
    k += 1
print(k > 0, worst)
